View the Weekly Sale Flyer... Made For Food Lovers – By Food Lovers… The Market Basket opened its doors in 1960 as a family-run gourmet market and catering company. More than 60 years and 3 generations later, The Market Basket is still recognized as one of New Jersey’s best gourmet grocery stores, providing customers with individual care and a unique experience. Open 7 days a week, customers can treat themselves to store-made prepared foods, fresh produce, an expansive deli, prime meat, fresh seafood, store-made baked goods and so much more.
